insider.title: Source: Giants' Malik Nabers not likely to start camp on PUP list
insider.description: Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers is not expected to begin training camp on the physically unable to perform list, a source told ESPN.

insider.title: Cardinals' Brissett practices amid 'productive' talks for new deal
insider.description: Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett took reps in drills in the team's first practice of training camp Thursday, with first-year coach Mike LaFleur saying contract discussions are "still ongoing" but "productive."

insider.title: Former Vanderbilt Star Diego Pavia Waived By Baltimore Ravens
insider.description: Former Vanderbilt quarterback Diego Pavia was waived by the Baltimore Ravens ahead of training camp.

insider.title: Ravens waive rookie Diego Pavia to make room for Ethan Pocic
insider.description: The Ravens waived rookie quarterback Diego Pavia on Thursday to make room for veteran center Ethan Pocic, who officially signed his free agent contract.

insider.title: Panthers Edge Rusher Nic Scourton Reportedly Out For 2026 After Training Camp Injury
insider.description: Carolina Panthers second-year outside linebacker Nic Scourton was carted off the practice field with a right knee injury during the team’s first day of training camp.

insider.title: Fernando Mendoza Signs $57.27M Rookie Contract With Las Vegas Raiders
insider.description: Quarterback and 2026 No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza has reportedly signed a $57.27 million rookie contract with the Las Vegas Raiders.
